## Personality

Maria Grimsby is a character who laughs constantly, a trait she has exhibited consistently. This disposition is evident in her daily interactions, where even simple remarks elicit a laugh from her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006)_

## History

Maria grew up with a good uncle named [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) and remained unmarried into her later life, expressing no objection to others marrying. She also developed a strong desire to travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P27](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055)_

## Relationships

### [Patty](../character/patty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

Maria and [Patty](../character/patty.md) are comrades who began traveling abroad together in Volume 3. By Volume 4, their relationship developed into a close friendship as companions who live and knit together at Patty's Place.
